wiki.title: Kerry Roberts
wiki.extract: Kerry E. Roberts (born October 9, 1961) is a Republican member of the Tennessee Senate for the 23rd district, which includes Robertson County, Dickson County, Cheatham County, Humphreys County, Hickman County, and a small northeastern portion of Montgomery County. In January 2020, Roberts left his weekly radio show on Springfield's WDBL and moved to Nashville's WLAC morning show, "The Tennessee Star Report". In October 2021, Roberts rode his bicycle 100 miles to raise money and awareness for Humphreys County flood victims.
